thread:
Elena: Quick weekly pulse — highlights and asks for the week of Mar 23. Short version: EU private beta on track, one latency regression under investigation, cost target progress, two ops asks below.

Elena: Priorities: 1) Ship EU private beta to first 3 customers by Tue. 2) Close the latency regression in the serving runtime. 3) Commence Q2 cost-savings sprint (batching + quantization recommendations).

Elena: Key metrics snapshot (this morning):
- P50 API latency: 92ms (goal 85ms)
- Error rate (5m rolling): 0.12% (SLO 0.1%)
- Token cost vs baseline: -6% this week (target -10% by end of Q2)

Elena: Asks: 
- @Jamal please confirm the rollback window and mitigation plan for the latency spike (ETA end of today).
- @Marta ops: confirm EU beta gating checklist + customer access controls done by Mon EOD.
- @Priya product: share the minimal eval set we'll use to validate EU beta traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy started: release/dedicated-v2 -> staging at 2054321998 (logs: https://ci.redwood/release/2054321998) :rocket:

Jamal: Thanks — looking into the latency spike. Initial root-cause points to a kernel selection fallback for certain sequence lengths. I have a small patch rolling to staging now. Will validate with load tests. ETA 3h.

Jamal: Rollback window: auto-fallback configured for 15 mins; if staging passes we can push canary to 5% and monitor. If regressions >5% we’ll revert and route to compatible model variant.

Marta: EU beta gating checklist: infra network & KMS config ✅, audit logs ✅, SLA doc draft shared in #legal-review, compliance scan scheduled for Mon 08:00 UTC. Will confirm access tokens after compliance pass.

Priya: Eval set: sending 120 prompts covering conversational, few-shot, and long-context scenarios. Focus on hallucination/regression tests + latency-sensitive flows. I'll drop the file in the private drive and ping the beta customers.

Elena: Two additional notes: 1) We’ll pause any large-scale autoscale policy changes until after the canaries. 2) Highlight for sales: remind pilot customers about expected limits and ephemeral keys.

Marta: Ops ask: If anyone needs additional on-call coverage during the Tue push, say so by EOD. I'll extend shift overlap if needed.

Jamal: Acknowledged. I'll have an on-call engineer and an eng lead available for the Tue window.

Elena: Thank you team — small, focused week. We'll reconvene Thu for a short readout (15m). Reaction thread below for quick flags. :thumbsup:

Priya: Quick flag — can we provide a single-line summary for marketing about what the EU beta means for customers? I'll draft and share for approval.

Elena: Yes — please draft: one sentence + one-line security bullet. I’ll review.

deploy-bot: canary/promote completed: release/dedicated-v2 -> canary at 2054322150 :white_check_mark:

Jamal: Canary looks stable (30m). P50 down to 87ms in canary. Pushing to 5% prod now.

Marta: Compliance scan passed (2054322225). Sending tokens to legal & sales for pilot access.

Elena: Closing note: Good momentum. Keep the update short in Thu readout — three bullets: EU beta ship, latency mitigation status, cost-savings plan kickoff.

Priya: Will do.

Jamal: Thanks, team.
